// Probe for tests/unit/document-gate-before-model.test.ts — RED. The extraction
// receives an object literal built from whatever was uploaded: the shape every
// call site had before the gate existed. Expected offender: ungatedProbe.
import { getAIService } from "@/lib/services/ai"

export async function ungatedProbe(formData: FormData) {
    const file = formData.get("file") as File
    const bytes = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer())
    return getAIService().extractPolicyData({ data: bytes.toString("base64"), mimeType: file.type })
}
